title: [review] tx_queue.py:400: pop() bypasses transmission st
description: pop() calls self._entries.pop(0).data directly instead of using _remove_first(). This skips packets_transmitted increment, max_latency_ms update, and avg_latency_ms EMA calculation. TxQueueStats will undercount transmissions and have inaccurate latency metrics if pop() is used in any code path.
